stories.headline: DERELIKT brings PS1-style sci-fi horror to PC on November 13
stories.summary: Visuwyg and Hyperstrange are scheduled to release their narrative retro FPS later today on PC. Set at a failing research outpost near Saturn, the game blends survival-horror combat, environmental puzzles and exploration in a claustrophobic science-fiction setting. A demo is already available.

stories.headline: Exterminauts closed PC beta begins November 13
stories.summary: Behaviour Interactive and Level Infinite's three-player cooperative PvE shooter begins a closed PC test at 03:00 today. The test introduces specialized power-tool weapons, new objectives, additional alien pests and another hostile worksite. Players can request access through Steam, although invitations are not guaranteed.

stories.headline: id Software confirms a new Hugo Martin-led game after layoffs
stories.summary: The studio says its teams in Texas and Frankfurt are developing their next project under game director Hugo Martin. The confirmation follows layoffs at Xbox and id Software, but the developer has not revealed the game's name, platforms, release date or gameplay. It says more details will take time.

stories.headline: Marvel Rivals warns against unfair mods and tweaks, plans stutter fixes
stories.summary: Creative director Guangyun Chen says modifications that grant combat advantages, such as simplified maps, amplified enemy footsteps or memory injection, are forbidden and may result in penalties. The studio also says it is working on client optimizations to address stuttering, but has not confirmed when those fixes will arrive.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; Colette Kress takes interim role
stories.summary: Nvidia confirmed co-founder Jensen Huang has stepped down as CEO, president and board director. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO while the board begins a search for a permanent successor. The company says it expects its product roadmap and customer commitments to continue without interruption.

stories.headline: PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted returns December 3 with a top 20 countdown
stories.summary: PC Gamer will broadcast its Most Wanted event on December 3, with Frankie Ward returning as host and Midas and Jules Gill leading the pre-show. The program will count down 20 anticipated PC games, with new game announcements and trailers expected during the broadcast.

stories.headline: Wolfenstein 3 officially enters production at MachineGames
stories.summary: Xbox and MachineGames have confirmed that Wolfenstein 3 is in production, with BJ Blazkowicz returning and actors Brian Bloom and Debra Wilson involved. The studio has not announced a release window or platforms. The confirmation follows years of speculation about a third main entry in the series.

stories.headline: Fable shows four minutes of new Albion gameplay
stories.summary: Xbox has released a four-minute gameplay trailer for Playground Games' Fable reboot, following two heroes through Deepwood and showcasing dialogue, exploration, melee and ranged combat, and magic. The open-world RPG is scheduled to launch on February 23, 2027, with a Steam pre-purchase page already available.

stories.headline: Hearts of Iron IV Expansion Pass 3 brings a US overhaul and Romania DLC
stories.summary: Paradox released Expansion Pass 3 on November 12, outlining a major rework of the United States and other American nations in the upcoming expansion, alongside more diplomatic options in a future theater pack. A Romania-focused add-on arrives on November 19, while the pass's three newly arranged songs are available immediately.

stories.headline: Overwatch ex-director Jeff Kaplan describes years of Blizzard clashes
stories.summary: Former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan says he frequently disagreed with Blizzard executives over the game's direction from 2018 onward, opposed the early announcement of Overwatch 2, and resisted pressure to put new heroes behind payments. The claims come from a new retrospective interview about the period before his 2021 departure, not a current change to the game.

stories.headline: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra launches at 20:00 with Twitch Drops
stories.summary: Grinding Gear Games' free 3.30 expansion is scheduled to start at 20:00 today on PC and consoles. Covens of Umbra adds a new challenge league, Fates that increase boss difficulty and rewards, a revamped Atlas and Threads of Creation replacing Scarabs. A launch Twitch Drops campaign runs until November 22 at 20:00, granting the Umbral Tentacle Slam Rare Finisher Effect after three hours watching eligible streams. A separate Umbral Portal Effect requires two eligible paid or gifted Twitch subscriptions.

stories.headline: Overwatch season 6's omnic detective is named Hudson, and he's a Damage hero
stories.summary: Blizzard developers inadvertently revealed that the upcoming omnic detective is named Hudson during a conversation about his design. Originally planned as a Support hero, Hudson was moved to the Damage role as his mechanics evolved. Game director Aaron Keller says the character received the highest scores of any hero tested by the studio's internal and external research groups. A precise arrival date has not been announced.

stories.headline: AMD Adrenalin 26.11.1 fixes excessive system-drive writes on newer Radeon cards
stories.summary: AMD's optional Adrenalin Edition 26.11.1 driver lists fixes for excessive system-drive writes while idle on Radeon RX 7000-series graphics cards and newer, plus unwanted writes when resizing or moving windows. The company has not established how much SSD wear the issue may have caused, and it has not confirmed an equivalent fix for older RX 6000-series cards. This is an optional driver release rather than an automatic update.
